spec.claim_summary: Long DCA ladder triggered by 4h RSI(14) dropping below 28 with five scaled averaging rungs and 3% take-profit above average entry.
spec.untestable_reason: The strategy is a DCA averaging ladder with scaled rungs and average-entry take-profit that cannot be expressed as single-entry rules.
assumptions: Assets assumed as BTCUSDT from page context; claim text names no asset.
Direction assumed long because take-profit above average entry implies a long ladder; claim never states long/short.
Base trigger read as 4h RSI(14) crosses_below 28 on bar close from 'drops below 28'.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Five averaging orders at fixed deviations (-2%, -5%, -9.5%, -16%, -25%) with 1.8x size scaling per rung and ladder-averaged entry pricing cannot be expressed in single-position rules.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Take-profit 3% above average (ladder-averaged) entry cannot be expressed as a fixed target from the base entry, so no target was set.
Test Period January 1, 2024 - June 29, 2026 and performance figures are recorded in claimed only; engine tests all available history.
